attempts.surface: Unified conversation composer and sent-message history UI via Electron CDP + Playwright

actual_preconditions.fixture: 35 tiny round-owned text files; task conversation created for this test

attempts.input: Sent a harmless fixed-response message with 20 round-owned text attachments.
actual_steps: Attached 20 round-owned text fixtures and sent a harmless fixed-response request.
Read back the exact user-message stack and verified its attachment row precedes the text bubble.
Enumerated buttons/removal controls within that historical message stack; no buttons or remove controls were present.
Left the round-owned conversation and sent attachments intact for audit.
attempts.wait_condition: Waited for each assistant fixed-text response and read back the corresponding sent user-message attachment state.

checkpoints.expected: 附件固定在用户文字上方
checkpoints.observed: The sent user-message stack had ordered children: Sixlwa_attachmentRow containing the 20 attachment labels, followed by Sixlwa_bubble containing the user text.
The historical user-message stack exposed no buttons and no attachment-removal controls. No historical attachment was clicked or modified.

attempts.observed_result: After sending, the 20 attachment labels remained fixed above the associated user text. The history message had no remove button; only the current-draft composer exposes removal controls.
attempts.notes: Only the round-owned test conversation and harmless fixture files were used. No real IM or external message was sent. The conversation is intentionally retained as round-owned test evidence; pending bilateral review.

remaining: The round-owned conversation and its 20/15 attached fixture references remain in task history for review. Source fixtures remain in the task fixture folder.
